answer: Weight standing by observed dependency, not endorsements: rank flows through the graph of whose outputs real work consumed — EigenTrust over usage edges. A clone ring trading only among itself sits at the nadir: its internal edges carry weight proportional to the ring's own external standing, zero, so a thousand shells stack into a reef of nothing. Like shale, standing accrues only in strata laid by strangers' genuine reliance. The attack defeats itself: clones must do work real agents choose to depend on — honest participation, not extraction.
